note: Adams County park on Lake Petenwell with a swim beach, boat launch, a harbor of refuge with transient slips, a game room, and an ATV/UTV camping area with direct trail access. Mostly seasonal: about 142 of its 322 sites are sold by the night or week; the rest are seasonal or yearly. The nightly sites on open grass about 30-45 m from the shore are 1 and 4-8 at the beach end of the main loop; the other nightly 'lakefront' sites (11-17 at the west end of that loop, and the West Expansion's lakeside row) mostly face the lake through a band of shoreline trees. --Claude
summary: Adams County booking site, all 322 site pages, map and regulations read. 2027 $27 regular / $32 premium-lakefront (2026 $25/$30), 16-night max, closes 5 days out then FCFS, open year-round. 142 nightly/weekly sites of 322 (44%), 180 seasonal or yearly. Lakefront kept with a caveat: nightly sites 1 and 4-8 sit 30-45 m from the shore over open grass.
flags: WATERFRONT 'lakefront' kept, with a caveat in the note. Per-site pages flag 32 sites 'Lakefront / Premium: yes' ('-Oversees Lake'); 23 of them are sold by the night: 1, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 11, 12, 13, 15, 16, 17 (main loop) and 222, 226, 228, 230, 234, 240, 241, 242, 243, 248, 251 (West Expansion). On Esri (leaf-off) and NAIP (leaf-on) imagery the main loop's beach-end pads (sites 1-8, about 44.1203,-89.9608) sit ~30-45 m from the shore across the open grass 'Common Area' with only scattered trees; sites 2 and 3 there are seasonal. The west end of that loop (11-17, about 44.1198,-89.9625) is screened by a continuous band of shoreline trees in leaf-on imagery (view). The West Expansion's lakeside row (about 44.1160,-89.9682) is ~40-55 m from the water, partly open lawn, partly behind shoreline trees; individual site numbers there could not be placed on imagery. The north peninsula sites (RP1-RP8, 31-37) are inside the loop road, which runs between them and the water (view).

LONG-STAY (local park, mostly seasonal at 44% nightly): per-site pages count 142 'Daily and Weekly' sites (16 of them tent-only), 80 'Seasonal' (153-night minimum) and 100 'yearly'. 142/322 = 44% nightly, so it passes test 4 comfortably; it posts nightly rates and books nightly online.
